examples.text: Tom me saca de mis casillas.
¿Por qué nunca me sacas a cenar?
examples.en: Why don't you ever take me out to dinner?

examples.text: Saca la toalla de la bolsa.
examples.en: Take the towel out of the bag.

examples.text: Tom tampoco te saca demasiada altura.
examples.en: Tom isn't much taller than you.

examples.text: Saca la toalla de la piscina.
examples.en: Fish the towel out of the swimming pool.
